verdict.rationale: Jira's Cloud REST API is explicitly versioned, with v2 and v3 documented and v3 marked as the latest. Atlassian also publishes a formal REST API policy: deprecated cloud APIs stay available in original form for at least 6 months, deprecated endpoints should return RFC 9745 headers, and a dedicated section explains how versions are exposed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation policy is honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: This documentation is for version 3 of the Jira Cloud platform REST API, which is the latest version.
a deprecated REST API in the cloud environment must remain available in its original form "for at least 6 months"
deprecated endpoints should return RFC 9745 response headers, and a dedicated API-versioning section describes how versions are exposed
